exposure: CT scan within 3 months prior to IVF/ICSI vs. no CT scan
chest computed tomography (CT) examination within 3 months prior to IVF/ICSI
no chest CT examination within 3 months prior to IVF/ICSI
outcome: Number of good quality cleavage stage embryos
cohort: 2680 couples undergoing IVF/ICSI fresh embryo transfer cycles from January 2019 - August 2020
finding: The study found that chest CT examination before IVF/ICSI did not have a significant impact on pregnancy and neonatal outcomes.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were comparable between the groups that had and had not undergone CT examination.
birth_weight: Assessed but no significant difference found between groups
